memories.text: I live with two flatmates in Pune near Koregaon Park, and the power cuts in summer are rough.
I build data pipelines at Deccan Motors, and half of them break every Monday.
I'm a data engineer, so Spark jobs and broken schemas are my daily bread.
Strong filter coffee is my fuel, and I drink it from a steel tumbler like my grandfather.
Keep your answers under five sentences unless I ask for detail.
Mom worries for nothing, I'm not allergic to milk, I just don't love paneer.
My elder brother Vikram lives in Chennai with his wife and twin daughters.
Our on-call handover happens on Mondays at 10.
Pipeline release steps: run the backfill on a one percent sample, compare row counts, and only then flip the feature flag.
I've been moved onto Ganga, a project that detects fraud in payment streams.
Ganga is at the design doc stage, lots of whiteboard arguments.
I joined the Sinhagad Trekkers Club, we hike a fort every second Sunday.
Spent a long weekend exploring the temple ruins at Hampi on a rented bicycle.
I'm allergic to prawns, which makes beach holidays a bit stressful.
For dosa batter I soak rice and urad dal for six hours, grind them smooth, and ferment overnight.
Correction: the on-call handover moved to Tuesdays, Mondays were overloaded.
My cousin's wedding is going to be in Jaipur this winter.
Ganga is owned by the Western Cooperative Bank, they're our biggest client.
Ganga is blocked while we wait for data access approval from compliance.
Went to the IPL final at Wankhede and lost my voice cheering.
The wedding moved to Udaipur, the family wanted a lake palace.
We feed a stray cat on the balcony who now acts like she owns the flat.
I don't eat meat, I've been vegetarian since college.
Remind me to renew my PAN card details before the end of December.
I moved to Bengaluru in April, and the weather alone makes it worth it.
I joined Kaveri Fintech in April as a senior engineer on the payments team.
Kaveri Fintech is headquartered in Mumbai, so I fly there once a quarter.
My manager is Anjali Rao, she built the risk platform there.
Anjali lives in Hyderabad and comes to Bengaluru for sprint planning.
I registered for a sprint triathlon in December, swimming is my weak spot.
I've switched from coffee to masala chai, my sleep is so much better.
Ganga is now processing two million transactions a day in production.
Spent a week in Goa over New Year, mostly avoiding seafood shacks.
I completed the sprint triathlon, slowest swimmer but I finished.
Before any trek I pack three litres of water, a headlamp, and tell someone the route.
I've never been to Europe, but Switzerland is first on my list.
Carnatic music in the background helps me focus on hard bugs.
Remind me to book flights for my cousin's wedding before the 15th of August.
